heading: ITR-3 & ITR-4: Key Schedules and Verification for AY 2026-27
tldr: Taxpayers with business or professional income must carefully choose between ITR-3 and ITR-4 based on their income type and turnover.
ITR-3 is for individuals and HUFs with income from business or profession, requiring detailed financial statements.
ITR-4 (Sugam) is for individuals, HUFs, and firms opting for presumptive taxation under Sections 44AD, 44ADA, or 44AE.
Thoroughly review and reconcile key schedules like P&L, Balance Sheet (for ITR-3), and business income (for ITR-4) with your financial records.
Always verify your income and TDS details against Form 26AS and Annual Information Statement (AIS) to prevent discrepancies.
caption:
Confused about which ITR form to use if you run a business or have professional income? Choosing between ITR-3 and ITR-4 is super important to file your taxes correctly. One is for detailed accounts, the other for simpler, presumptive tax. Get it wrong, and you might face issues! This guide helps you pick the right one and verify your details. Read more to simplify your tax filing.
